title: Plunder: a Pirate MMO. Pre alpha testers needed!
author: igotlagg
selftext:
**Plunder** is a co-op pirate game you play in your browser, nothing to download. You and up to three friends crew one ship and do every job on her by hand, and several crews share the same sea.

**What's in right now**

* Sail a sloop, brig or galleon yourself: wheel, sails, braces, anchor, pumps and guns. Hired hands fill any empty berth, so you can also sail solo.
* Load and fire the cannons by hand. If you get holed, go below to patch the leaks and pump her out before she sinks.
* Cutlass combat (combos, parries, rolls, finishers) plus pistol, blunderbuss and musket.
* Close to fifty islands, an undead fleet that boards your ship, a kraken, storms and fog.
* Batter a merchant until she gives up, beat her crew and sail her home as your prize.
* Treasure maps in bottles, digging, fishing, sunken wrecks to loot.
* 60 voiced quests, Liar's Dice on the quay, and an outfitter and sailmaker to dress up your pirate and your ship.

**What I need from you**

It's pre-alpha, so expect bugs and rough edges. What helps most:

* Play for 20 to 30 minutes, solo or with a friend.
* Tell me where you got lost, stuck or bored. First impressions are worth gold right now.
* Report bugs with a screenshot and what you were doing: broken colliders, falling through things, ships acting strange, all of it.
* Tell me your browser, your GPU and how well it ran.

**How to play**

* Play here: [https://3d.plunder.be](https://3d.plunder.be)
* Discord for feedback, bug reports and finding a crew: [https://discord.gg/2P8hyshZzS](https://discord.gg/2P8hyshZzS)
* Works best in Chrome or Edge on a desktop with keyboard and mouse.

Thanks for giving it a go. Every report gets read, and plenty of what testers have reported so far has already been fixed.

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body:
Hello! I want to give you some feedback as a follow dev, who already has a released and actively played game on Steam!

First of all i was sceptical "Another MMO", rolled my eyes and clicked. Expecting nothing, really. The Trailer also didn't convince me much but it's pre alpha, it's good that there even is a trailer! So i gave it a shot. 

Character creation is nice and my first thought was: Okay, these assets look familiar. Probably Synty, i don't know. But now my first question: How far can you go with Assets? I always try to have a workflow to reproduce everything i need infinitely, but it looks like you're bound by your bought assets? How far can you go with models, i'd like to know. 

Other than that, the character creation was pretty solid for a pre-alpha. So i started the game, of course there are some model/animation issues. I had them aswell in 3D. But thats where my next question rose - are those pre made Animation? They sure look like they are, again, how can you expand upon it, if using finished assets? Any plans? 

So anyways. I picked up my gear, which was well shown with the arrow even through walls. I ran out everytime i grabbed something and had to return twice lol. But thats just an user error. Combat was very basic but understandable from the getgo. Dodge, Hit, Use Pistol, kill the scourge. Inventory looks clean aswell, i would make it reziseable / dynamic based on screen resolution. It seemed a little small for me. But other than that, a good start. Then i had to fire the cannon on top of the roof and here i ran into my issue - i picked up the cannonballs, manned the cannon, pressed R to load and.. nope, i couldn't shoot. Left Click was greyed out and not useable. So thats where my testing ended, i would've played further to test sailing because thats the part i was really really curious about. But i can't get there. Can you take a look at that?

replies.author: igotlagg
replies.body:
First of all, thanks!!

I jsut tested it, and it seems like "other pirates" have broken the left cannon. I tried the right one and that one does work. Ive never experienced that bug before, but I only playtested myself alone, so this is a multi user bug I will fix ASAP.

You can skip the tutorial at start and go straight to the main port, but thats only available before starting the quest. Ill fix it so you can skip it regardless.

About the animations, these are all pre recorded animations, some with a mix of IK, some with my own tweaking. Mind that I already had an extensive library of assets before LLM's were a thing!
